title: LORD, REMIND ME THAT NO BATTLE IS GREATER THAN YOU
text: Before we go into this place in the spirit this morning, I want to ask you to do something very simple. Share this prayer with someone. Share it right now. There is somebody in your circle, somebody in your family, somebody you know who woke up this morning under the weight of something they cannot explain. They are carrying a burden that language has not been sufficient to describe. Send this to them. Tag them. Forward it. Because what God is about to do in the next few moments is not just for you. It is a word sent by heaven to find the people heaven has targeted in this morning. Do not underestimate the assignment of this moment. Share it now and then come back because we're about to step into something glorious. Father, we thank you. We thank you because you are God. And that alone, that alone is enough reason for everything inside of us to be at rest. You are God this morning. You were God last night. You will be God when this day closes. And there is no version of our lives, no dimension of our experience, no chapter of our story where you ceased to be [music] God. So, we come before you with gratitude, with open hearts, with expectation because we know that you are here. Now, I want you to settle your heart. Wherever you are watching from this morning, whether you are in your room, whether you are in transit, whether you pick this up in the middle of your morning routine, I need you to pause. I need you to become spiritually present. Because what I have noticed about the enemy's strategy in this season is that he does not always come with dramatic attacks. Sometimes he comes with distraction. Sometimes he comes with noise. Sometimes he comes with the busyness of the ordinary. And in the middle of the ordinary, he attempts to make you forget something so critical, so foundational, so absolutely essential that if you ever forget it, you become vulnerable to every wind that blows. And what he wants you to forget is this, that no battle in your life is greater than the God who lives inside of you. Let me say that again and let it penetrate. No battle in your life is greater than the God who lives inside of you. The prophet Isaiah records in chapter 40 verse 28, Has thou not known? Has thou not heard? That the everlasting God, the Lord, the creator of the ends of the earth fainteth not, neither is weary. There is no searching of his understanding. Now, I want you to notice something. The Holy Spirit did not inspire Isaiah to write that passage for academic purposes. He wrote it because there would come a season, a season exactly like this one, a moment exactly like the one you are in, where the people of God would look at their circumstances and begin to conclude wrongly about God. They would begin to look at the size of their challenge and subtract from the magnitude of their God, and heaven said, "No, we must remind them. We must remind them of who God is." I want to talk to you this morning about the ministry of divine reminder because there is something the Lord wants to do for you today that goes beyond information. He's not trying to teach you something new necessarily. He's trying to remind you of something ancient, something eternal, something that was true before your problem existed, something that will remain true long after your problem has been silenced. In Deuteronomy chapter 1, when Moses was speaking to the children of Israel, he reminded them of something they had forgotten. He said, "The Lord your God who goes before you, he will fight for you according to all he did for you in Egypt before your eyes." Now, catch what Moses was doing. >> [music] >> He was not preaching a new doctrine. He was reminding them of a demonstrated reality. He was saying, "You have evidence. You have proof. You were there when God showed up. You watched the Red Sea split. You tasted the manna. You drank from the rock. You have watched God be God in real time. How then how then are you standing at the border of your promise terrified? And I believe that is the conversation heaven is having with some of us this morning. [music] You have evidence. You have a testimony. There was a time God showed up for you in a way that was undeniable. There was a moment in your life where you could not explain what happened except to say God did it. You [music] prayed and heaven moved. You called and the answer came. You were at the end of yourself and suddenly suddenly provision appeared. And yet this morning you woke up looking at your situation and somewhere between last night and this morning fear crept in. Doubt crept in. Discouragement crept in. And the enemy whispered this one is too big. This time it is different. This battle this one you cannot win. And the Lord says to you, "Let me remind you. Let me remind you that I am still the same God. Let me remind you that my arm is not shortened. Let me remind you that what I did before I can do again. Let me remind you that the God of your yesterday is the God of your today and he's the God of everything that is coming." Numbers 14, I love this passage. When the spies came back from Canaan, 10 of them came with a report contaminated by fear. They said, "We are not able to go up against the people for they are stronger than we." And then they said something devastating. They said, "There we saw the giants and we were like grasshoppers in our own sight and so we were in their sight." Now the theologians among us will understand what happened there. Their self-perception became their reality projection. >> [music] >> They saw themselves as small and because they saw themselves as small, they concluded that their enemies saw them the same way. But Caleb Caleb had a different spirit. Numbers 14:9, "Only do not rebel against the Lord nor fear the people of the land for they are our bread. Their protection has departed from them and the Lord is with us. Do not fear them. Do not fear them. Their protection has departed from [music] them. Because when God is with you, the tables turn. When God is with you, the battle does not belong to the biggest army. When God is with you, the battle does not belong to the loudest voice. When God is with you, the battle belongs to the Lord and the Lord has never lost a battle. He has never fought a battle and returned in defeat. Every enemy that has ever stood against the purposes of God has been dismantled. Every kingdom that has risen against the kingdom of God has crumbled. Every Pharaoh who has told God's people you shall not go has eventually watched them leave. And what God did then, he is doing now. I want you to understand something about the nature of spiritual battles. Every battle you face is fundamentally a battle of perception before it is a battle of circumstance. The enemy knows he cannot stop God. What he attempts to do is convince you that God has stopped. He attempts to distort your perception of God's involvement in your situation. If he can make you believe that God is distant, that God is disinterested, that God is somehow limited by the complexity of what you are facing, then he has won without firing a single shot. Because a believer who does not know who God is in their situation is a believer who will not pray with authority. They will not speak to their mountain. They will not stand on the word. They will shrink back. They will negotiate with the enemy. They will settle for less than what God has prepared. But when you know, when you truly know, when it is not just intellectual agreement but revelatory conviction, when you know that the God of the universe, the God [music] who spoke worlds into existence, the God who holds the stars in their courses, the God before whom nations are like dust on a scale, when you know that this God is personally, specifically, deliberately involved in your story, everything changes. Romans 8:31. Paul asked a question that is one of the most powerful questions in the entire canon of scripture. What then shall we say to these things? If God be for us, who can be against us? Now, I need you to understand the force of that question. Paul was not asking a rhetorical question with no answer. He was making a declaration so massive that it took the form of a question to let you participate in arriving at the conclusion. He's saying, "Think about it. Think deeply. If the omnipotent one, if the all-knowing creator, if the sovereign Lord of the universe is on your side, what exactly is the opposition working with? What does the enemy have that God does not have [music] more of? What weapon has been formed against you that God cannot dismantle? Who is your enemy ultimately? Is he bigger than God? Is he smarter than God? Does he have resources God does not have access to? The answer to every one of those questions is no, and that no becomes the foundation of your confidence. I need to speak to someone this morning who has been under sustained attack, not just a one-time difficulty. I mean sustained, consistent, relentless pressure that has come against you from multiple directions. Attacks in your health, pressure in your finances, confusion in your relationships, setbacks in your career or your business, and you have been standing, and you have been praying, and you have been believing, and yet it feels like the attacks are not stopping. And there is a part of you that is beginning to wonder whether your faith is working, whether God is hearing, whether there is something wrong with you. Let me say this to you with all the apostolic clarity I can muster this morning. Sustained attack is not evidence that God has abandoned you. Sustained attack is evidence that the enemy considers you a serious threat. You do not deploy sustained attack against something that is not advancing. You do not send consistent pressure against something that is already defeated. The enemy does not waste resources. He attacks what matters. He attacks what is moving. He attacks what is aligned with heaven's agenda. And the fact that you are under pressure is not a sign that God has left it. It's a sign that you are close to a breakthrough that hell is desperate to prevent. Hear me. Psalm 34:7, "The angel of the Lord encamps around those who fear him, and he delivers them." Around, not occasionally passing by. Encamps. Sets up strategic, permanent, intentional positioning around you. The battle is happening, yes, but you are not unprotected in the battle. You are surrounded by the angelic assignment of heaven. You are covered by the blood of the lamb. You are hidden in the secret place of the Most High. You dwell in the shadow of the Almighty, and everything that attempts to reach you must first pass through God. Job. Let us talk about Job for a moment. When Satan came before God and asked for permission to attack Job, notice the conversation. God asked Satan where he had come from, and Satan answered that he had been walking to and fro on the earth. And God said to him, "Have you considered my servant Job?" Now, I want you to understand something in that conversation. Satan could not just attack Job at will. He had to appear before God. He had to get access. He had to acknowledge the boundary that God had placed. And even when God permitted the testing, God set the limits. You can touch what he has, but you cannot touch him. And when that boundary was pushed further, God said you can touch [music] his body, but his life is preserved. Even in Job's worst moment, God had drawn a line that the enemy could not cross. And I want you to know that the same God who set limits for Job's enemy has set limits for your enemy. The devil is not unlimited in his access to your life. He is not free to do whatever he wants to you. He operates under the sovereign permission and governance of a God who loves you. And everything that is permitted, even the difficult things, even the painful things, even the things you cannot understand is being worked together [music] by a God who has declared in Romans 8:28 that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose. Let me shift now into prayer. Because this is where things must become real. Information without activation is incomplete. And this morning heaven is not just trying to inform you, heaven wants to encounter you. Heaven wants to touch you. Heaven wants to strengthen the inner man. Heaven wants to remind you in a way that goes beyond the ear and lands in the spirit. So, I need you to open your mouth now. Wherever you are, I need you to begin to engage. Do not be passive this morning. Passive prayer is not a weapon. Passive faith does not move mountains. You must engage. You must [music] be present. You must show up in the spirit with everything inside of you. Father, in the name of Jesus, we come before you this morning from different places and different situations. We come with different burdens and different histories, but we come to the same God. We come to the unchanging, unfailing, all powerful God [music] who has never been surprised by anything we are facing. Lord, we are asking you this morning, remind us. Remind us that you are God. Remind us that the battles we face are not bigger than you. Remind us that we have not been abandoned in the middle of our situation. Come, Lord Jesus. Come, Holy Spirit. [music] Be present in this moment in a way that shifts the atmosphere around everyone engaging with this prayer right now. Father, I lift up every person whose faith has been under siege. Every person who prayed last year and is still waiting. Every person who stood on a promise and has not seen it manifest yet. Every person who has done everything right and yet the situation seems to remain the same. Lord, I am asking you to breathe on their faith this morning. I am asking you to strengthen what is weak in them. I am asking you to restore what discouragement has stolen. Lord, let them feel you right now. Let the presence of the Holy Spirit descend upon them with such tangible reality that doubt has no room to remain. Father, let every lying report of the enemy be silenced this morning. Every whisper that says it is over, silence it, Lord. Every voice that says the promise will not come to pass, we rebuke it in the name of Jesus. Every suggestion that you have forgotten them, that you have moved on, that they have missed their season, we reject it by the blood of the lamb. And we declare that God is not a man that he should lie, neither the son of man that he should repent. He has spoken it, he will also do it. >> [music] >> He has promised it, he will also bring it to pass. Lord, right now in the name of Jesus, I speak to every mountain of impossibility, every mountain of lack, every mountain of sickness, every mountain of marital delay, every mountain of stagnation in business and career, every mountain of family crisis and confusion, hear the word of the Lord this morning. Every mountain, you shall be removed. Not by might, not by power, but by the spirit of the living God. For who art thou, O great mountain? Before Zerubbabel, thou shalt become a plain. And he shall bring forth the headstone thereof with [music] shoutings crying, "Grace, grace unto it." Grace. Grace is available this morning. Not because you have been perfect, not because your faith has been consistent, not because your prayer life has been flawless, grace is available because God is good. Because his mercies are new every morning. Because his compassion fails not. And grace is speaking [music] over your situation right now. Grace is saying, "What your effort could not accomplish, my favor will complete. What your strategy could not reach, my goodness will overtake. [music] I will do exceedingly and abundantly above all that you have asked or thought according to the power that works in you." Father, I take authority now over every spirit of fear that has been operating in the lives of those engaged with this prayer. Fear is not from [music] God. 2 Timothy 1:7 declares it plainly, "God has not given us the spirit of fear, but of power and of love and of a sound mind." So, right now, we command the spirit of fear to leave. We command the spirit of anxiety to be dismantled. We command the spirit of dread and the spirit of panic and the spirit of impending doom leave in the name of Jesus. We loose the spirit of power. We loose the spirit of love. We loose the spirit of a sound mind. Let clarity come. Let peace come. Let holy confidence come. Lord, I declare right now that the people of God are not grasshoppers. They are not victims. They are not helpless. They are more than conquerors through Christ Jesus who loved them. They are the head and not the tail. They are above and not beneath. They are blessed when they come in and blessed when they go out. The enemy that rises against them one way shall flee before them seven ways. No weapon formed against them shall prosper. And every tongue that rises against them in judgment shall be [music] condemned. This is the heritage of the servants of the Lord. This is what heaven has established. And what heaven has established, no force in hell can dismantle. Father, I pray now for the battles that have been going on too long. The situations that have dragged on and tested the endurance of your people. Lord, you are not a god who is slow concerning your promise. You are a god of precise timing. And this morning I'm asking you for every long-standing battle. Let there be a sudden shift. Let there be a turn. Let what has been resisting suddenly yield. Let what has been dry suddenly overflow. Let what has been silent suddenly speak. Let what has been locked suddenly open. For you are the god who opens doors that no man can shut and shuts doors that no man can open. Father, I am asking you for signs and wonders in the lives of everyone connected to this prayer this morning. Let testimonies come out of this moment. Let this be a day that people remember. Let this be the morning they say I was praying and something broke. I was seeking God and the answer came. I was in that place in the spirit and when I opened my eyes the situation had changed. Lord, let your glory be seen. [music] Let your power be demonstrated. Let the world know that there is still a god who answers prayer. There is still a god who fights [music] for his people. There is still a god who is not intimidated by anything the enemy has assembled. Now, I want to do something before I bring this word to a close. >> [music] >> I want us to engage in what I call prophetic declaration because faith is not silent. Faith speaks. Romans 10:17 tells us that faith comes by hearing and hearing by the word of God. And Romans 4:17 tells us that God calls those [music] things which are not as though they were. There is a language of faith. There is a grammar of the kingdom that does not wait for circumstances to change before it speaks. It speaks and the circumstances change. So, I need you to open your mouth right now and make these declarations over your life. [music] Say this, I am not afraid of what I am facing this morning. I am not afraid because God is with me and God is greater. I do not walk by sight. I do not evaluate my future by my current circumstances. I walk by faith. I operate by revelation. And by revelation I declare that the one who is in me >> [music] >> is greater than any force that has been assembled against me. Greater is he that is in me than he that is in the world. The God of the impossible is my God. The God who split the Red Sea is my God. The God who brought down the walls of Jericho is my God. The God who raised Lazarus after four days is my God. And this same God, this same unlimited, uncreated, undefeated God is fighting for me right now. I declare that my battles are turning. What the enemy meant for evil, God is turning for [music] good. What has been coming against me is now going to work in my favor. The weapons that were formed shall not prosper. The plans of the enemy against my life shall be reversed. Every evil projection, every satanic assignment, every demonic program against my destiny, I cancel it now in the name of Jesus. By the authority of the blood of Jesus Christ, every assignment of darkness against my life is dismantled. Every stronghold built by fear and doubt in my mind is pulled down. Every lie the enemy has told me about my God, about my future, about my capacity, I renounce it now. I replace it with the truth of the living word of God. I declare that I am coming out of this season. I am not staying here. I am not settling here. I am not building a house in this wilderness. I am moving forward. I am advancing. I am going from glory to glory, from faith to faith, from strength to strength. Every good thing God has prepared for me is coming. Every promise he has spoken over my life is coming to pass. Not one word shall fail of all the good things the Lord has spoken. Not one. And I will see the goodness of the Lord in the land of the living. I declare divine health over my body. Every symptom of sickness, every report of the enemy against my physical body, I reject it by the stripes of Jesus Christ. For he was wounded for my transgressions, bruised for my iniquities, the chastisement of my peace was upon him, and with his [music] stripes, I am healed. Past tense. Completed action. I am healed. I receive it now. I walk in it now. I declare divine provision over my finances. My God shall supply all my needs according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus. The spirit of lack has no jurisdiction over my life. The spirit of poverty has no authority in my household. The blessing of Abraham is mine by faith in Christ Jesus, and the blessing of the Lord maketh rich and added no sorrow with it. I am blessed. I am provided for. I am prospering, spirit, soul, and body, even as my soul prospers. I declare divine order in my relationships. Every confusion, every manipulation, every demonic interference in my marriage, in my family, in my relationships, I rebuke it in the name of Jesus. Let the peace of God govern every relationship in my life. Let clarity come where there has been confusion. Let love be restored where there has been breach. Let healing come where there has been pain. I declare that my destiny is secured in God. Every plan the enemy has for my future is dismantled. Every gate he has attempted to close against my advancement is reopened [music] by the blood of Jesus. Every door he has tried to shut against my purpose is thrown open by the hand of God. I will not miss my season. I will not miss my moment. I will arrive at my destiny. I will fulfill the assignment of heaven over my life. The counsel of the Lord shall stand concerning me. And there is no human vote, no demonic strategy, no circumstantial obstacle that can stop what God has purposed for my life. Father, let everything I have declared this morning be ratified in heaven. Let it be sealed by the blood of Jesus. Let it be confirmed by the Holy Spirit. And let the manifestation of every declaration come quickly and fully in a way that brings glory to your name. Lord, I ask you one final thing this morning. Stay close. Stay close to everyone who has prayed this prayer. When the day gets difficult, and for some it will, when the battle reports come in, and they may, when the circumstances seem unchanged on the surface, remind them. Lord, keep reminding them that no battle is greater than you. Remind them in their quiet moments. Remind them when they are tempted to worry. Remind them in the middle of the night when fear tries to return. Remind them with a scripture. Remind them with a testimony. Remind them with your presence. Let them feel you close. Let the awareness of your nearness be the anchor that holds them through every storm. Because the God who is for us is greater than anything that comes against us. And that is not motivation speech. That is not positive thinking. That is not the gospel of optimism. That is the unshakeable, eternal, tested and proven, scripturally grounded, historically demonstrated, experientially confirmed reality that our God fights for us. Our God has never lost a battle. Our God is in this moment exactly what he was in every moment recorded in scripture. Faithful, powerful, present, engaged, and undefeated. We receive everything heaven has released in [music] this moment. We receive it by faith. We receive it by the blood. We receive it in the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, the same yesterday, today, and forever. Thank you, Father. Thank you. Thank you. Thank you. Let everyone say, "It is well." It is well with my soul. It is well with my future. It is well with my family. It is well because God is well and God is with me. Amen.
